widget.name: Course Content Navigator
widget.description: LMS-style course content navigator for Mendix — supports nested sections, multiple content types (Video, Article, Quiz, Resource, Assignment), progress tracking, expandable descriptions, and composable Mendix architecture.

property.caption: Content Items
property.description: A list datasource of course content items (lessons, articles, quizzes, etc.).

property.caption: Title
property.description: String attribute for the content item title.

property.caption: Description
property.description: String attribute for the expandable description text shown below the item title.

property.caption: Content Type
property.description: String attribute indicating the content type: "Video", "Article", "Quiz", "Resource", or "Assignment". Defaults to "Video" if empty.

property.caption: Section / Group
property.description: String attribute for the section/group path. Use "/" to create nested sections (e.g., "Module 1/Lesson 1/Practice"). Items with the same path are grouped into collapsible sections.

property.caption: Duration
property.description: String attribute for the item duration display (e.g., "1:11", "5 min read", "10 questions").

property.caption: Status
property.description: String attribute indicating the item status: "NotStarted", "InProgress", "Completed", or "Locked". Defaults to "NotStarted" if empty.

property.caption: Is Previewable
property.description: Boolean attribute indicating if the item shows a "Preview" badge (like Udemy's free preview lessons).

property.caption: Sort Order
property.description: Integer attribute to control the display order of items within a section. Items are sorted ascending by this value.

property.caption: Active Item ID
property.description: Expression returning the ID (GUID) of the currently active/selected content item. Used to highlight the current lesson.

property.caption: On Item Click
property.description: Action triggered when a content item is clicked (not fired for Locked items). Use this to navigate to the selected content — open a video, display text, start a quiz, etc.

property.caption: Show Summary Bar
property.description: Display the summary bar at the top showing section/lecture counts and total duration.

property.caption: Course Title
property.description: Expression returning the course title shown in the summary bar header.

property.caption: Show Duration
property.description: Display duration values for each content item.

property.caption: Show Content Type Icons
property.description: Display icons indicating the content type (video, article, quiz, etc.).

property.caption: Show Numbering
property.description: Display hierarchical numbering for sections and items (1, 1.1, 1.2, etc.).

property.caption: Show Status Indicators
property.description: Display completion status indicators (checkmark, progress dot, lock icon).

property.caption: Enable Descriptions
property.description: Allow items with descriptions to be expanded via a chevron toggle.

property.caption: Accordion Sections
property.description: When enabled, expanding one section automatically collapses sibling sections at the same level.

property.caption: Expand All by Default
property.description: When enabled, all sections are expanded when the widget first loads. Otherwise, only the section containing the active item is expanded.
